answer: Route every reward along attestation edges and cap the trust-flow crossing from the honest core into any cluster. Picture the honest agents as one watered orchard: a sybil swarm is a mirage oasis grafted on by only a few genuine vouchers, so the bottleneck of real endorsements, not the count of fakes, limits what it can drain. To widen that channel toward the horizon an attacker must buy more authentic vouches, each costing real work, making ten thousand masks worth no more than the handful of true edges feeding them.
